body:
After my first use of Catuaba I'm left excited about its effects, though I totally misused it this time.  I'm not sure about how normal or unique my personal composition is - I'm in my mid 20's, I smoke pot daily, sometimes take other herbal supplements, etc.  Have done mushrooms for the first and second times recently, tried a huge bowl of standard Salvia and felt nothing but a little vibrating.
Anyway, my one suggestion is to not try this before bed.  I wasn't exactly up all night - I fell right to sleep, probably because I was baked, but I woke up at 2am like usual to take a leak and I couldn't get back to bed.  Had to retoke and take some Valerian extract, and it still took a couple hours of trying to meditate on the sound of the air conditioner.  I'm exhausted today.
Oh yeah, and I was sort of like Bob from Enzyte.  Uncontrollable wood.  First time I've ever been totally rock hard without feeling turned on at all, so it was a little different.  Had to take care of that, so to speak, and it still wasn't entirely satisfied.  I can really see a use for this, and I only tried it before bed because I heard it can lead to erotic dreams.  That didn't happen to my knowledge, even with the help of Valerian, which I have found almost guarantees me great dreams.
A totally useful substance, but until I know it better I won't be taking it after noon anymore.
